name: sharegpt-english-10k-vllm-serving-benchmark
description: A 10k-sample ShareGPT prompt set intended to benchmark LLM serving systems (particularly vLLM) by exercising realistic conversational prompts. It is used to measure inference performance (latency, throughput) and functional correctness of model responses under production-like loads. The dataset is oriented toward system-level benchmarking rather than model capability evaluation.
evaluation_method: latency_throughput (latency ms, tokens/sec) and optional qualitative human_eval of response quality
reputation: Niche but practical dataset hosted on Hugging Face; used primarily by practitioners evaluating inference performance of serving stacks like vLLM.
